resource_texts.fact_12: Hire Lady Hilda, a seasoned fighter in chain mail and shield who is staying at the Clumsy Fox, to join the dragon hunt. Her fee is not yet set.
resource_texts.fact_43: Walk about three miles through the forest to Brandon's Barrow Mound and recover the magic sword buried with Brandon. Father William says the dragon can't be killed without it, though George says no one knows what is true of the legend.
resource_texts.fact_39: Collect the sleeping potion Ingrid is brewing from the diluted faun wine and help her give it to Warwick, so Dunk can enter his house and shop for the mithril shirt without Warwick waking. The potion isn't finished, and its strength is unproven because the faun wine was heavily diluted.

rules.last_session: standalone beats rated low importance are dropped by code before assessment; threads/standalone events retain medium-or-high impact AND lasting consequence; an otherwise unrepresented encounter may also qualify with medium-or-high historical value, regardless of enduring consequence; no scene or character quota; validated main-event anchors sorted by Ledger position
rules.want: supported end and completion significance; primary adventure, other adventure, then meaningful side; importance and stable ties, not actionability; serves_thread is null (an end, not a means) and significance is not incidental (Goals: parent_goal_id null, significance not incidental)
rules.owe: definite_end; commitment_type is not general_agreement; stake, burden and consequence are not trivial (Obligations filter)
rules.blocked_by: active, persists beyond the scene, not covered by immediate danger, and blocks a thread holding a shown want, debt or opening
rules.could_use: openings only; supported enabling action toward a shown want/debt; direct role; equivalent offers/plans use validated canonical fact references; assets stay in state/history
rules.unknown: open_ended investigative objective: revelation with all four dimensions medium/high, or grounded/inspectable adventure-objective question linked to a shown adventure want; ordinary gaps excluded
rules.threat: harm_origin is not party and no evaluation is low (Brewing Troubles filter); not covered by an immediate danger
rules.all: never possibly moot facts; no caps; no assets in open matters

last_session.change: Dunk discovered a glowing magical mithril chain shirt in Warwick's shop and told the party he has a plan to get it.
The party trapped the invisible Clurichen Naggeneen in the Golden Egg's basement, learned he was a drinker emptying the bars, and Quinn hung him in a bag behind the bar.
Learning Ingrid's secret love for Warwick, Dunk struck a deal for her to brew a sleeping potion for the smith, fetched faun wine for it, and secretly diluted the wine before handing it over.
Dr. Uriah visited the prejudiced Father William, who measured his hands and feet for webbing, explained that the dragon needs Brandon's sword, marked his map, and extracted a promise of penance.
Father William marked the witch's home and the Barrow Mound on Uriah's map, and the party planned to check a marked location on the way to the Barrow.
George revealed that the dragon's lair lies north at the foot of the mountains and that it will soon fly, and he and Father William said only Brandon's magic sword can kill it.
Trout recruited the halfling Squints into his 'Halfling Corps' with promised treasure terms, and Squints later freed Brother Dirk, who Trout put under his command.
Dunk danced with the fauns, astonished them by drinking their wine with no effect, and traded a child's lucky rabbit's foot for a flask of faun wine.
Dr. Uriah bonded with Ingrid over their dislike of Father William, hearing her view of the forest faith and the encroaching fairies, and bought her remedies.
Having learned that the dragon can only be killed with the magic sword buried with Brandon, the party set out for the Barrow Mound to get it.
The party found a giant's cottage in the woods, stole its captive Brother Dirk from under it, and outran it.
